dialogue.Introduction: Name is Marlon. I run the Adventurer's Guild up by the mines, and yes, I sell guns. Good, sturdy, reliable guns. Care to take a look, @?$h
dialogue.Mon: Monday already? Adventurers do not care about days. We care about whether our powder is dry.
dialogue.Tue: Tuesday mornings are for cleaning barrels. I could fire a musket blindfolded, but I would rather not fire one dirty.
dialogue.Wed: Wednesday, and the mines are full of slimes again. Good business for me, @. Bad news for the slimes.$h
dialogue.Thu: Thursday. Quiet day on the trail. Quiet days make me restless, so I polish the barrels twice.$u
dialogue.Fri: Friday evening I shoot targets behind the guild. Do not tell the Nurse. She says it is bad for my ears.$h
dialogue.Sat: Saturday, and the saloon is full of miners bragging. Half of them could not hit the barn from inside it.$h
dialogue.Sun: Sunday I rest. Well, I rest the way a gunman rests, with one eye open and a loaded revolver on the table.
dialogue.Mon2: Oh, you are back, @. Keep your eyes on the cave entrance when you go down there. The things inside do not wait for a fair fight.
dialogue.Tue6: You have been down in the mines a lot lately. I can tell by the bruises. Keep the Nurse's number close, friend.$h
dialogue.Wed2: New shipment came in with rocket designs. The Demolitionist is thrilled, and I have been told to keep my distance from him.$h
dialogue.Wed6: Wednesday evenings I count the coins and sort the ammo. Counting is the only thing in life that never shoots back.$h
dialogue.Thu6: I was a soldier once, you know. I left the army because I got tired of watching friends die over the wrong cause. Now I just sell the tools and let people choose.
dialogue.Fri2: On Fridays the Tavernkeep sends me his worst customers. I sell them weapons, they buy a drink, then they complain about the price.$h
dialogue.Sat6: You know what I like about this valley? Everyone here has a reason to hold a weapon, and almost nobody uses it on a neighbor. Makes a man proud to sell them.$h
dialogue.Sun2: Sunday, @. Finally a customer who does not talk my ear off. Keep it that way and we will get along fine.
dialogue.Mon4: Good to see you, @. I was hoping you would drop by. Anyone who buys from me tends to stick around, and you are worth keeping around.$h
dialogue.Tue4: Tuesday rolls on. I keep a special barrel of rare ammo behind the counter for you. Do not ask me where I got it.$h
dialogue.Wed4: Wednesday, and I finally finished tuning the Minishark. It fires like a hornet with a grudge. You will love it.$h
dialogue.Thu4: Thursday brings the caravans from the desert. They always bring stories, and I always buy the best ones.$h
dialogue.Fri4: Friday nights, the guild is quiet and I can actually hear myself think. That is when I do my real planning.$h
dialogue.Sat4: Saturday. I look forward to these days more than I will admit to anyone at the saloon.$h
dialogue.Sun4: Sunday, @, and I have been meaning to thank you. Not many people in this valley treat me like a person instead of a weapon merchant.$h
dialogue.Mon8: @, you are one of the few people I trust with the good stock. Do not make me regret it. Actually, I hope you never do.$l
dialogue.Tue8: I do not talk much about my past, but you deserve to know. I came here to start over, and you helped me do it.$s
dialogue.Wed8: Every time you come through that door I feel a little less like a lonely gunsmith. Thank you for that, friend.$h
dialogue.Thu8: Sometimes I think about retiring to a quiet farm, growing carrots and never touching a trigger again. Then I remember I would miss you too much.$h
dialogue.Fri8: Friday, and I have something to confess. I kept the best revolver from my old war for a reason. I wanted someone worth giving it to.$u
dialogue.Sat8: Saturday, @. Let us sit on the guild steps and watch the stars for a bit. Nothing else needs doing today.$h
dialogue.Sun8: Sunday. I know I always act tough, but if the mines ever take you, I hope you come back here first. Promise me that.$s
dialogue.summer_Wed: Summer heat makes the powder sweat. I keep the barrels in the cool cellar now. Ask me how I know.$h
dialogue.spring_Mon: Spring means the mines wake up and so do the monsters. Keep your musket loaded, @.
dialogue.fall_Tue: Fall is my favorite season. The leaves on the mountain look like flames, and the hunting is good.$h
dialogue.winter_Fri: Winter in the valley is brutal. The snow gets into the gun oil and freezes the triggers. I spend half my day with a heater and a rag.
dialogue.summer_Sat: Summer Saturday, and the Luau crowd is already gossiping about who brought the best soup. I brought a crate of fireworks. Do not tell anyone.$h
dialogue.spring_Thu: Spring Thursday, and the baby slimes are everywhere. Cute little things, but they still bite. Watch your step on the trail.
dialogue.fall_Sun: Fall Sunday, and the Stardew Valley Fair is almost here. I am entering a shooting contest. I intend to win.$h
dialogue.winter_Mon: Winter Monday, and I am cleaning every barrel while the fire crackles. There is nothing like a warm guild on a cold morning.$h
dialogue.fall_15: Halfway through fall and the monsters from the forest are restless. Be careful out there, @.$u
dialogue.summer_20: Midsummer and the Skull Cavern is getting noisy. I have stocked extra bullets. You are going to need them.$h

rainy: Rain on the guild roof, and the powder stays dry only because I keep it inside. Stay out of the storm, @.$h

situations.eye: Heard you took down that giant eyeball in the sky. I would have bought you a drink if the saloon had one left.$h
situations.evilBoss: The Eater of Worlds or the Brain of Cthulhu is gone. Good riddance. Those things sold my ammo faster than I could make it.
situations.skeletron: Skeletron is finally defeated, and the dungeon is open. The Old Man was freed, and he came by the guild to thank me. He tried to buy a sword.$h
situations.queenBee: The Queen Bee is no more. The honey in the jungle smells sweeter now, but I still will not go near the hive without a shield.
situations.hardmode: The Wall of Flesh has fallen and hardmode has begun. The Hallow is spreading and the monsters are meaner. Time to restock the good stuff, @.$u
situations.mechs: One of the mechanical bosses was destroyed last night. Nice work. I could hear the explosion from the guild and I loved every second of it.$h
situations.plantera: Plantera is defeated. The jungle temple is open now. I hear there are treasures inside, so I am already polishing my gun.$h
situations.golem: The Golem has been destroyed. The temple stone is quiet again, and I am happy to sell the new parts to anyone brave enough to ask.
situations.cultist: The Lunatic Cultist is defeated and the celestial pillars have appeared. I do not understand what they are, but they look expensive.$u
situations.moonLord: The Moon Lord is gone. The sky is quiet, and so am I, which is the best kind of quiet for a gun dealer.$h
situations.goblins: A goblin army came through last night, and you sent them packing. Good. They owe me money for three crossbows.$a
situations.pirates: The pirates tried to raid the beach and you stopped them. The Pirate is glad you did. I am glad too, since I was almost out of cannonballs.$h
situations.frostLegion: The Frost Legion is repelled. Ice gets into everything, but the Frost Legion got into my shipment and froze half my rifles. Thank you for stopping them.$a
situations.martians: The Martian Madness is over. Those ray guns are not for sale, and I told the Martians so in person. They did not seem to understand.$u
situations.bloodMoon: There was a blood moon last night. The zombies were thick outside the mines, and I sold more bullets than I have in a month.$u
situations.eclipse: We had a solar eclipse last night. Monsters came out in the daylight. Half the guild stood guard and the other half hid under the table.
situations.party: The Party Girl is throwing a party today, and I have been asked to bring fireworks. I plan to bring the loudest ones in the valley.$h

festivals.spring13: The Egg Festival is here. I hid a rare bullet inside an egg for the kids. If they find it, they get a fine gun. If they do not, the chickens will.$h
festivals.spring24: Flower Dance tonight. I brought a tulip for the dance and a sharp rifle to keep the wolves away from the grange. Do not let me dance on your toes.$h
festivals.summer11: The Luau is here, and everyone has added something to the community soup. I added a jar of gunpowder. Strictly for flavor, of course.$h
festivals.summer28: The Dance of the Moonlight Jellies is tonight. The jellies glow on the beach and the guild is nearly empty. I think I will finally take a night off.$h
festivals.fall16: The Stardew Valley Fair is open. The grange displays are wonderful, and I have a shooting contest to win. Wish me luck, @.$h
festivals.fall27: Spirit's Eve is spooky tonight. The haunted maze is full of ghosts, but I have a silver bullet for every one of them. Do not get lost, friend.$u
festivals.winter8: The Festival of Ice is here. The ice fishing is fun, but I am only interested in the snow sculptures. I am building a snow cannon. It is perfectly safe.$h
festivals.winter25: The Feast of the Winter Star is today. I got you a secret gift this year. It is a box of ammo with a bow on top. Do not open it before the feast.$h

loved.text: Ha! Now that is a gift a gunsmith can respect. Solid metal, and a bit of muscle behind it. Thank you, @.$h

liked.text: Useful stuff, and worth a few coins. Every adventurer needs a little extra for the road. Thanks, friend.$h

neutral.text: Hm. Not my usual business, but I suppose it has a use somewhere. Thanks, @.

disliked.text: Seeds and milk? I am a gunsmith, not a farmer. Take it back and maybe find a flower shop.$a

hated.text: Are you trying to insult me? Food and junk in my guild? Get that out of my sight, @.$a

help: Bit of help here? This one has teeth.
Need a hand! I am reloading, not running!
Somebody cover me, I am out of bullets!
thanks: Ha! You fought like you were paid for it, @. Good work.$h
Thanks, @. That was a close one. I owe you a rifle and a drink.$h
You covered my back when it counted, @. I will not forget it.$s
battle: Come on then, I have been waiting all week!
Ha! Eat lead, you overgrown slime!
For the valley! Nobody bites my neighbours!
Hold still so I can hit you properly!
courage.hurt: Those things hit harder than they look. The Nurse has me on bed rest, so I am stuck here till morning.$s

danger.boss: A boss is loose out there, @. I have loaded every barrel I own. Let us go hunt it.$h
danger.invasion: Goblins, pirates, whatever this is, they are at our gates. I am already loaded, @. Are you coming?$h
danger.pumpkinMoon: Pumpkin Moon tonight, and the scarecrows are walking. I cannot decide whether to laugh or shoot. I will shoot.$h
danger.frostMoon: Frost Moon tonight, and the snowmen are coming. Keep your hands warm, @, and your trigger finger warmer.$h
danger.eclipse: Eclipse. Monsters out in broad daylight. Grim work, but somebody has to do it, and it is us.$u
danger.bloodMoon: Blood moon tonight. The zombies are thick outside the mines. I am sharpening everything, @. Let us go.$u

events.after: Keep the crates away from the stove, and do not shoot the Guide's books.

steps.say: Oh! @, you startled me. Come in, come in, mind the crates. Half of them have live fuses in them.$u
Relax, that was a joke. Mostly. Nothing has exploded in here yet.$h

answers.reply: Looking is free. Buying is how I keep the lights on.$h
Now you are speaking my language. Lean in, this one is special.$h

steps.say: Here, a box of musket balls. Every adventurer runs out faster than they expect.$h
Hmm, you are sharp, @. I like that in a customer.$h
Hey, Demolitionist, put that dynamite down before you singe the grass. We have company.$a
Relax, it is only a little one. The best boom always starts small.$h
@, I have been thinking about trying my rarest bullets. They are yours if you help me test them.$h
Fine, fine. I will stand back. Way back.$h

steps.question: Should we test them on a slime?

answers.text: Yes, let us blow up a slime.
answers.reply: Ha! A slime with ambition. I like it.$h
Safer, and the wood is worth a few coins.$h

steps.say: Oh, @. Come sit down. It is late, and I do not usually let people see me like this.$u

Years ago I served in a war nobody remembers. I learned to shoot to protect, and I learned a gun is only as good as the hand that holds it.#$b#I left all of that behind when I came to the valley. Nobody here asks me to be a soldier.$s

answers.reply: Sometimes is honest. I think that is all the old days deserve.$s
It does. Thank you, @. You make it easier to sleep.$h

steps.say: Thanks for listening. I rarely talk about the old days. I feel lighter now, and I did not expect that.$h
Goodnight, @. The guild will be quiet, so you can walk home safely.$h
Would you look at this, @. The sea is calm, and I am standing next to a man who once tried to sell me a cannon he did not own.$h
Arr, that was a fair trade, matey. Half water, half rum, all fun.$h
I want to be honest about something. Your friendship means more to me than any barrel of gold.$h

answers.text: Only when the Pirate is steering.
answers.reply: Ha. The Pirate would be honored. Maybe a little too honored.$h
Fair. But the sea trusts you more than you know.$h

steps.say: Stay here with us a while. The sea and the sand are good company.$h

events.after: Keep that revolver clean, and let me know when you want more ammo.

steps.say: @, I have something for you. Stay still a moment.$u
This revolver came with me from the old war. I have fired it at monsters and at bad memories. I want you to have it.$s
You have been a true friend to me, better than any customer. I trust you with this.$h

answers.reply: Then it is in good hands. Good.$h

answers.text: I will shoot anything that moves.
answers.reply: Hm. Maybe I should have kept this one.$a

steps.say: Off you go, adventurer. Come by the guild anytime. The ammo is always on the shelf.$h
